source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 583 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 583 was established by Ordinance No. 24304, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 28, 2000. Ordinance No. 24304 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 24304; 25163)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 583 is established on property fronting approximately 308 feet on the southwest line of Cass Street, beginning at a point approximately 349 feet southeast of the southeast line of Amelia Street. The size of PD 583 is approximately 1.8 acres. (Ord. Nos. 24304; 25163)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 24304; 25163)

sections.title: Development/ Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.104. DEVELOPMENT/ LANDSCAPE PLAN.

(a) Development and use of the Property for overnight general purpose shelter, group residential facility, and child-care facility uses must comply with the development/landscape plan (Exhibit 583A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development/ landscape plan, the provisions of this article control.

(b) For all other uses, no development plan is required and the provisions of Section 51A- 4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. Nos. 24304; 25163)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in this section, the uses permitted in this district are all uses permitted in the IR Industrial Research District, subject to the conditions applicable in that district, as set out in the Dallas Development Code, as amended. For example, a use permitted in the IR Industrial Research District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this planned development district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the IR Industrial Research District is subject to DIR in this planned development district, etc.

(b) Group residential facility.

(c) Overnight general purpose shelter. [By right if the use provides shelter for no more than 250 overnight guests; otherwise by SUP only.]

(d) Child-care facility. (Ord. Nos. 24304; 25163)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this district:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. (Ord. Nos. 24304; 25163)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front yard. Minimum front yard is 15 feet.

(b) Side and rear yard. No minimum side and rear yard.

(c) Density. Group residential facility use must have no more than 100 beds. The overnight general purpose shelter use must have no more than 250 beds. The cumulative maximum permitted number of beds for all uses combined is 250.

(d) Floor area ratio. Maximum floor area ratio is as follows:

(1) Group residential facility: 15,000 square feet.

(2) Overnight general purpose shelter: 25,000 square feet.

(3) Group residential facility and overnight general purpose shelter uses combined: 25,000 square feet.

(4) Retail and personal service uses: 0.5.

(5) Lodging, office, and retail and personal service uses combined: 0.75.

(6) All combined uses: 2.0.

(e) Height. Maximum structure height is 200 feet.

(f) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 80 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations, but surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(g) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(h) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is 15. (Ord. Nos. 24304; 25163)

sections.title: Fence
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.108. FENCE.

For overnight general purpose shelter and group residential facility uses, a six-foot-high screening fence must be provided around the Property as shown on the development/landscape plan. For all other uses, consult Section 51A-4.602. (Ord. Nos. 24304; 25163)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) For group residential facility uses, 0.25 of an off-street parking space is required per bed, with a minimum of four spaces required.

(b) For overnight general purpose shelter use, 0.0025 of an off-street parking space is required per bed, with a minimum of four spaces required.

(c) For all other uses, consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(d) Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Division 51A-4.300 et seq.) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally.

(e) For group residential facility, overnight general purpose shelter facility, and child-care facility uses, parking must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 24304; 25163)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 24304; 25163)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping for group residential facility and overnight general purpose shelter uses must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(b) For all other uses, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(c) Plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 24304; 25163)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 24304; 25163)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.113. ACCESS.

For group residential facility and overnight general purpose shelter uses, ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 24304; 25163)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(c) For group residential facility and overnight general purpose shelter uses, high occupancy transportation, such as buses or vans, must be available for use by clients.

(d) For group residential facility and overnight general purpose shelter uses, loading and unloading of high occupancy vehicles must be conducted at the rear entrance in the location shown on the development/ landscape plan.

(e) Group residential facility and overnight general purpose shelter uses must be secured by trained security personnel at all times. No fewer than four trained security personnel may be on duty from 4:00 p.m. to midnight; no fewer than three trained security personnel may be on duty from midnight to 6:00 a.m.; and no fewer than two trained security personnel may be on duty from 6:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.

(f) For group residential facility and overnight general purpose shelter uses, the owner shall establish a community review committee which shall meet as follows: once every three months for the first year; once every six months for the next three years; and once a year for the remaining lifetime of this use. Membership of the review committee must include a representative from the nearby Sam Houston Elementary School, a representative from the nearest neighborhood association, and any property owner within a 500 foot radius of the Property to discuss problems and concerns and suggest improvements.

(g) The director of development services shall inspect the Property three years from the date of passage of Ordinance No. 24304 for the purpose of determining whether there has been compliance with the conditions of Ordinance No. 24304. The director shall then report his or her findings to the city plan commission. (Ord. Nos. 24304; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this planned development district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24304; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-583.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 583 is located on Zoning Map No. I-6. (Ord. Nos. 24304; 25163)
